# CRM Flow Lab

> CRM Flow Lab is an automation agency that builds CRM and marketing automation systems for dental clinics and med spas in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. It also builds n8n and Zapier business automations for any business. Founded by Usman Ali, who has about three years of hands-on experience building CRM and automation systems.

Key facts:
- Services: booking funnels, instant lead response (sub-60-second SMS/email), no-show reminders, review generation, hygiene recall and patient reactivation, complete CRM setup, and n8n/Zapier automation.
- Pricing: Starter from $497 one-time; Growth (managed) from $997/month; Scale (multi-location) custom. The software subscription is paid directly to the platform provider by the client.
- Typical launch time: 7-14 days from the strategy call.
- Clients own their account, data and automations. Monthly plans cancel with 30 days' notice.
- Contact: book a free 15-minute strategy call at https://www.crmflowlab.com/book
